purpose: Proposed QGIS-hosted Buffer command vertical slice. All IDs are illustrative, actual handlers and runtime APIs are UNINSPECTED, and no native operation or Archify rendering has run. Persistence is outside this flow; original projects/data remain unchanged and results use new output identities.

nodes.role: Proposed ribbon control and visible busy/error state on UI thread
Existing QAction/handler mapping to be inventoried; preserve semantic command identity
Validate active layer, selection, parameters, units and bounded task lifecycle on UI thread
Proposed supported in-process worker; actual target API and provider thread rules unresolved
Existing QGIS computation/provider engine with immutable inputs or supported worker-owned resources
Existing QGIS renderer/layer store; UI thread owns visible state changes

edges.contract: sample.buffer trigger; preserve the inventoried native action/handler rather than duplicating its algorithm or registering a conflicting shortcut.

Validate active dataset identity, selection, parameter bounds, source CRS and distance units. Unknown or invalid units/layer context return a typed rejection before task submission. No original dataset edits.

Immutable BufferRequest: opaque dataset/output IDs, validated parameters, CRS/unit identifiers and task generation token. Resolve supported worker-owned resources; do not pass live GUI/layer objects across thread boundaries without verified support.
edges.thread_owner: UI dispatcher to supported worker; actual runtime policy unresolved

edges.contract: Bounded provider/algorithm call using verified target APIs, read-only source and new output. Provider, algorithm ID, license and threading support require preflight; no concrete engine call is asserted by this example.
edges.thread_owner: Supported worker-owned engine context; unresolved until provider review

edges.contract: BufferResult: new output identity, status, output CRS/units, dimensions/counts and warnings. Preserve source metadata needed for independent semantic checks; a successful return alone is not acceptance evidence.
Typed provider/validation/cancellation error with sanitized message and output cleanup state; no credentials, raw coordinates or silent partial success.
Queue BufferResult to UI owner with matching task generation; reject stale/cancelled task results and validate output identity before layer registration.
Queue typed failure/cancellation to UI owner, preserve original data and identify any new incomplete output for bounded cleanup/recovery.
Bounded/coalesced progress events with matching task generation. If the actual provider cannot report percent, use an explicit indeterminate indicator rather than invented timings.

Cooperative cancellation token only when supported by the reviewed provider; otherwise disable cancellation with a visible explanation and bound task duration. Do not kill the host or claim immediate cancellation.
edges.thread_owner: UI request to worker-supported cancellation boundary

edges.contract: On accepted result, register new validated output and update visible layer/selection context on UI thread. Preserve source renderer/project state; actual engine output and visible behavior require T2/T3 checks.
Set busy/progress state and restore enabled/checked context after success, error or completed cancellation. Re-evaluate current active layer instead of restoring stale selection assumptions.
Display sanitized validation/provider failure or cancellation outcome and actionable recovery; preserve source state and distinguish partial outputs from successful results.

command_mappings.before: UNINSPECTED native QGIS menu/toolbar action; illustrative mapping only, full inventory missing.
command_mappings.after: Proposed ribbon Analysis group invoking the same inventoried semantic action, subject to supported plugin APIs.
command_mappings.handler: UNINSPECTED; reuse verified existing handler/provider contract after source preflight, no invented QGIS API.
command_mappings.shortcut: UNINSPECTED; preserve actual shortcut and avoid duplicate registration.
command_mappings.enabled_state: UNINSPECTED actual rule; proposed parity requires valid compatible active layer/context and bounded busy-state behavior.
command_mappings.checked_state: UNINSPECTED; preserve actual toggle behavior or document not-applicable only after inventory.
command_mappings.reason: Preservation is a proposed requirement, not observed parity or a complete command inventory.

async_policy.progress: Use reviewed provider progress, coalesce updates and marshal to UI thread; use explicit indeterminate state when percentage is unsupported.
async_policy.cancellation: Verify cooperative cancellation; expose unsupported behavior clearly and bound task duration. Report completion only after worker acknowledgement and state recovery.
async_policy.error: Return typed sanitized validation/provider/cancellation failures; preserve original data and distinguish new incomplete outputs from accepted results.
async_policy.recovery: Validate output before UI registration, reject stale/out-of-order generations, restore current enabled/checked context and leave source/project state unchanged on failure.
